question:
The value of a and b so that the following is probability mass function

 
 

 X:
 0
 1
 2
 
 

 P(X = x):
 3a
 3b
 4b
 
 

with mean 1.1, is:
solution:
The correct answer is **(0.1,0.1)**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The **probability mass function (PMF)** of a discrete random variable gives the probabilities associated with each possible value of the random variable. 
 
• The **mean of a random variable** can be calculated by taking the weighted sum of the possible values of the random variable, where the weights are given by the PMF.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** PMF** must satisfy the properties of a probability function, i.e. it must be non-negative for all values of the random variable, and the sum of the probabilities over all possible values must equal 1.
 
• The **mean of a random variable** provides a measure of the center of the distribution, and is commonly used in many statistical applications.
 
• To determine the PMF given a mean, it is necessary to know the possible values of the random variable, and their probabilities.
 
• The mean of a random variable is a parameter of the distribution, and can be used to describe the center of the distribution.
 
• The calculation of the mean requires knowledge of the PMF.
